title: Board view (triodian.raf.boardview.v1)
description: What AI Board Direction shows the board at each meeting: the positions the board approved (the calibration set as issued), where the appetite stands now, and the latest in-use measures. Served by AI Risk Appetite at GET /api/board-view (risk_appetite lib/core/api.js boardView()) and read over AI Board Direction's service binding.

approved.description: The calibration set as issued (the same body as GET /api/calibration-set), or null if none has been issued

approvedNote.description: Why nothing is approved, when approved is null

inUse.description: The latest in-use measures from the AI Use Assessment feed, or null if no feed is loaded

measures.description: The feed's measures as AI Risk Appetite holds them: each named and given the board's limit from the framework (risk_appetite public/app.js, loading the in-use feed on decision 3)

limit.description: The limit the appetite sets for it

value.description: The count or percentage, or null if the register cannot count it

basis.description: What was counted, or why it could not be

gapsByPriority.description: Open gaps by priority, or null

inUseNote.description: Where the measures came from, or why there are none
